required_authority.native_authority_refs: nonempty exact source-local ALLOW authority refs; each must resolve in the supplied AuthorityRegistry and occur in the EmpiricalFact authority closure

required_downstream_value_consumer.purpose: Directive 5 requires an actual existing downstream owner to dereference the native EmpiricalFact values; OC01 policy admission or a ref hash alone is not sufficient.

accepted_owner_1.required: exact DiscoveryAuthority, authority snapshot in the supplied registry, exact predicate catalog and query templates; at least one DISCOVERED_RESULT_SUPPORTED receipt

accepted_owner_2.required: the owner returns a SUPPORTED effective-N product; RAW NOT_APPLICABLE alone is not a substantive value effect

required_value_sensitivity.source_local: explicit measured original-value -> consumed-result comparison with restoration; otherwise source_value_sensitive=false and value_sensitivity.status=NOT_DEMONSTRATED
required_value_sensitivity.fixture_only: explicit measured fixture-value mutation/restoration may set fixture_value_sensitive=true, but source_value_sensitive remains false

required_observed_response_projection.required_contract_ref: exact contract_ref equal to the query grain observed_response_contract_ref
required_observed_response_projection.required_ledger: full exact ledger, including contract_ref and not_eligible_population_estimate
required_observed_response_projection.nonobserved_profiles: unchanged; no observed_response field is added
required_observed_response_projection.forbidden: synthesis, relabeling, population eligibility, or dropping the projection

loader_contract.command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m campaign_src04_completion.consumers.run native --producer-module MODULE:FUNCTION --expected-source-id SRC04 --claim-ceiling SOURCE_LOCAL_STATISTIC --use-scope SOURCE_LOCAL_STATISTIC --out campaign_src04_completion/consumers/evidence/SRC04_SOURCE_LOCAL_CONSUMER_PRODUCT.json

historical_baseline_not_full_producer.scope: 42 accepted response fields only; preserved historical evidence
historical_baseline_not_full_producer.reason: The directive requires the expanded 163/178-field source product; the 42-field release is immutable baseline evidence, not the full producer.

expected_result.source_value_sensitive: true only with measured SOURCE_LOCAL_CERTIFIED evidence; otherwise false/NOT_DEMONSTRATED
